skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the clip, add subtitles in Chinese and English, and export for WeChat...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best WeChat Video skill.
- Quickly create, edit, and export WeChat-ready videos by uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 200MB.
- Automatic WeChat video optimization: trim clips, add subtitles in Chinese/English, and export for WeChat sharing in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple setup with free 7-day token (100 credits); automatic session management.
- Cloud GPU-powered video rendering—no software installation needed.
- Supports common workflows: single/batch video edits, timeline previews, and iterative refinement.
- Clear error handling and helpful guidance built in for uploads, exports, and credits.
